system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: USGS Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS Collection 2 Tier 1 Raw Scenes

spatial_coverage.coverage: Landsat scene coverage over Bulawayo and surrounding terrestrial surfaces, subject to sensor availability, scene footprint, cloud conditions, and Tier-1 geometric-quality filtering.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2013-03-18 to present, subject to catalog holdings at evaluation time
data_description.spatial_resolution: 30 m optical grid; thermal bands originate at 100 m before catalog resampling; panchromatic B8 is 15 m
data_description.temporal_unit: Scene-based Landsat 8 observations with an approximately 16-day repeat cycle
analytical_capabilities: Perform multispectral land-cover and local-climate-zone classification from Landsat 8 raw scenes
Compare seasonal spectral patterns of built-up surfaces, vegetation, bare land, and water
Convert raw thermal digital numbers to radiance and brightness temperature using scene metadata
Estimate land-surface temperature after applying an explicit emissivity method
Map land-cover and thermal patterns while retaining Landsat 8 sensor provenance

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Raw quantized and calibrated digital numbers for multispectral and thermal bands; solar and view angles are supplied as angle bands.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1 only. These are Raw Tier-1 scenes, not TOA or Level-2 surface-reflectance/surface-temperature products; do not apply Level-2 SR/ST scaling factors. Landsat 8 optical bands are B2 blue, B3 green, B4 red, B5 NIR, B6 SWIR1, and B7 SWIR2; thermal bands are B10 and B11. Convert thermal digital numbers to radiance and brightness temperature using scene metadata, then apply an explicit emissivity method for LST. QA_PIXEL bit 0 is fill, bit 1 dilated cloud, bit 2 cirrus, bit 3 cloud, bit 4 cloud shadow, bit 5 snow, bit 6 clear, and bit 7 water. Use QA_RADSAT to reject saturated observations. Do not add Landsat 5, Landsat 7, Level-2, TOA, annual composites, or index-only products as required anchor data.

data_description.data_source: United States Geological Survey and NASA Landsat Program
